# Accepted equivalent mutants the pull-request gate (mutants-pr.yml) skips.
#
# One exact cargo-mutants name per line: `file:line:col: description`, as the
# gate prints it. Each entry needs a row with its justification in WORKFLOWS.md
# "Accepted equivalent mutants". The match is exact, so an entry stops applying
# when its line moves and the mutant is tested again; update or delete it then.
